def mostFreqChar(s: str) -> str:
    if not s:
        return ""
    n = len(s)
    m = 256
    counts = [0] * m
    first_pos = [-1] * m
    for i in range(n):
        c = ord(s[i])
        if first_pos[c] == -1:
            first_pos[c] = i
        counts[c] = counts[c] + 1
    max_count = 0
    result_char = ""
    result_pos = n
    for i in range(m):
        if counts[i] > max_count:
            max_count = counts[i]
            result_char = chr(i)
            result_pos = first_pos[i]
        elif counts[i] == max_count and counts[i] > 0:
            if first_pos[i] < result_pos:
                result_pos = first_pos[i]
                result_char = chr(i)
    return result_char

def main():
    test_cases = [
        "hello world",
        "abracadabra",
        "tie test",
        "A man a plan a canal Panama",
        "",
        "zzzzzz",
        "aabb",
        "123 321 123",
        "python programming",
        "été",
    ]
    for test in test_cases:
        result = mostFreqChar(test)
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
